goal: Model a simple wooden shipping crate from the starting mesh: a roughly 1m cube-shaped box with chamfered (beveled) edges and a shallow recessed/inset panel on each of the four side faces (the classic crate look), believable real-world proportions, watertight. Keep topology clean throughout: all-quad (quad_ratio >= 0.95), zero n-gons, zero non-manifold edges, poles only on flat interiors, within the triangle budget. Use inset/extrude/bevel and re-quad as needed.
